screen.legendarysurvivaloverhaul.datapac:
Your custom JSON configurations of Legendary Survival Overhaul are now OBSOLETE. LSO now uses DATAPACKS to REPLACE the JSON files.
A datapack-ready folder (named 'customDataPack') has been created in the config folder of LSO with all the custom values you have defined.

IF YOU PLAY ON A SERVER :

ON SERVER SIDE : 
1) Go in the legendary survival overhaul config folder (button on this screen)
2) Cut the 'customDataPack' folder
3) Go in the saves > 'Your world' > datapacks folder (still on SERVER side)
4) Paste the customDataPack folder here. Your custom configs will then work in game.

ON CLIENT SIDE : 
5) Go in the LSO config folder 
6) Remove the customDataPack & the json folders.

IF YOU PLAY LOCALLY :

Follow steps 1) to 4) but locally: cut paste the 'customDataPack' folder in the saves > 'your world' > datapacks folder.


DON'T FORGET to remove the json folder & customDataPack folders both on SERVER & CLIENT, otherwise this message will be rendered at every launch.
Legendary Survival Overhaul - WARNING - CONFIG NOW ON DATAPACK
